screening_constraints: Use only frozen pre-existing model behavior; do not optimize parameters against the descriptive contrast file.
Treat bootstrap intervals as descriptive because they do not model colony clustering.
Do not use the Y-maze in screening or model selection.
development_estimation_constraints: v0.3.2 locomotion-context estimation remains restricted to threshold-independent DCM-control observables pinned in poissonnier2026_h2_estimation_targets.json.

v0.3.3 painted-trail response development may use threshold-independent open-arena DCM and pheromone rows pinned in poissonnier2026_pheromone_response_targets.json, but only to estimate separately frozen pheromone-response parameters.
For painted-trail response estimation, baseline locomotion and all H2/H3/H4/H5 path-history parameters must remain fixed and may not be refit.
Painted-trail response parameters must be shared across short and long approach-history strata; treatment-specific or path-specific response parameters are forbidden.

Painted-trail response fitting must be based on pheromone-vs-DCM treatment contrasts within each path-length stratum so response parameters cannot absorb the unresolved baseline short-vs-long locomotion structure.
Moving-speed, moving-distance, straightness, Prop_time_moving, Average_Speed and Traveled_Dist are diagnostics only until AnimalTA movement classification is recovered.
The estimation tool may write reports only and may not update a canonical model file.
The Y-maze remains inaccessible to fitting, ranking, stopping rules and model selection.
